ocr_provenance.canonical_text_source: RapidOCR over every 200 dpi rendered physical page
ocr_provenance.page_order: physical PDF pages 1 through 32, processed sequentially
ocr_provenance.reading_order: single-column layout visually confirmed; boxes grouped top-to-bottom and left-to-right within each row

notes: All 32 physical pages were inspected in four readable contact sheets; pages 1-2 and 22-23 were additionally reconciled against their OCR text and page roles.

Original-resolution pages 3-21 and 24-32 were inspected for paragraph layout, all numbered equations 1-42, Tables 1-9, Figures 1-13, fuzzy matrices, flow charts, maps, and every displayed MATLAB code line.

The document is single-column throughout: page 1 Summary, page 2 Contents, pages 3-22 main technical paper and references, pages 24-25 magazine article, and pages 26-32 MATLAB appendix; page 23 is a sparse continuation of references.

RapidOCR is adequate for continuous prose but is not authoritative for mathematical notation, chart labels, matrix entries, or code punctuation; those elements were read from the rendered pages and remain subject to exact model-record transcription.
Orange QR/promotional blocks on physical pages 1, 27, and 29-31 are third-party watermarks and are excluded from author-language evidence.
No blank, missing, duplicated, clipped, encrypted, or multi-column physical page was found.

warnings: RapidOCR: OCR text is a reading aid; equations, chart labels, tables, and code require rendered-page verification.
RapidOCR: confidence scores are not calibrated transcription probabilities; low-confidence text is preserved without silent correction.
